Foundation `cmd /c run_lake_build.bat --no-pause` returned **PASS, exit 0**, followed sequentially by paper `cmd /c run_dubon_build.bat --no-pause`, **DEVELOPMENT PASS, exit 0**, with zero Lean diagnostics. Seven modules justify the finite Möbius lattice assembly under the genuine cusp integral and its exact Petersson residue. Division by the actual principal-character completion factor gives the primitive Eisenstein cusp continuation. The proved real unfolding identity extends to every Re(s)>1 by the analytic identity theorem on the connected half-plane, using actual real-axis values accumulating at 2. Removing (4*pi)^(-(s+k-1))*Gamma(s+k-1) constructs a continuation of the literal normalized coefficient square series. At positive integral weight it is holomorphic for Re(s)>1/2 away from 1. ### Actual completed Rankin convolution and polynomial strip growth — 7 October 2026

Foundation `cmd /c run_lake_build.bat --no-pause` returned **PASS, exit 0**, followed sequentially by paper `cmd /c run_dubon_build.bat --no-pause`, **DEVELOPMENT PASS, exit 0**, with zero Lean diagnostics. Coverage: 440 production modules, 183 exact consumers, 2,175 explicit registrations and 3,854 exhaustive theorem dependency checks. Sixteen linters passed across 2,605 declarations plus 1,760 generated declarations in the audit scope; focused consumer lint had 1,755 generated declarations. Source/inventory and tooling fixtures passed: 547 retained files, 378 local links, 4,320 unchanged existing Lean files.

Eight modules prove the actual integrated rectangular lattice reflection, an entire completion after removing both poles, and a quadratic bound on every closed vertical strip. The bound uses the genuine convergent cusp integral majorant, finite Möbius coefficients and positive real powers. The square-supported principal-character coefficient function is constructed by an injective square lift. Its actual Dirichlet series is proved equal to L(2s,chi_0). The genuine convolution with normalized cusp coefficient squares is a finite divisor-antidiagonal sum; each coefficient is real and nonnegative. Pinned Mathlib's L-series convolution theorem gives the exact product and the precise two-Gamma completion. At full level the completed convolution has the scalar s-to-1-s functional equation. At general levels the proved reflection is a finite rectangular lattice identity; no scalar functional equation is claimed there. Five exact consumers expose the literal integrals, coefficients, exact completion, strip bound and full-level reflection. These facts do not give the quantitative x^(3/5) summatory error. DUB-01–15 remain accepted; DUB-16–20 remain OPEN.

Ivić's historical full-level overview was rechecked on 7 October at https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0603013, Sections 1–3: the convolution and degree-four functional equation guide the next quantitative step. Its source estimate is not used as a Lean hypothesis or treated as current optimality evidence. No new frozen artifact or dependency upgrade was introduced.

### Actual rescaled cusp traces and common-period Mellin identity — 7 October 2026

The original product-level cusp form is translated by the actual inverse diagonal matrix. The mixed subgroup has exactly the upper-right divisibility by a and lower-left divisibility by b; its real image is proved equal to the diagonal conjugate of Gamma0(ab), and it contains Gamma(ab). Restricting each genuine integral coset translate to the normal principal subgroup therefore supplies one common period ab. The finite sum retains every actual coset once. Its Petersson density is full-level invariant, so its horizontal square energy is one-periodic. Exact averaging over ab periods and actual Parseval identify that unit-interval integral with the complete finite family of q-expansion squares.

Every actual normalized period coefficient family has a proved linear mean. Summing the genuine finite family and convolving with the full-level principal square sequence preserves nonnegativity and the linear mean, giving absolute convergence for Re(s)>1. The exact Mellin transform has factor (4 pi / ab)^(-(s+k-1)) Gamma(s+k-1). Absolute Bochner integrability is proved by summable integral norms; no formal exchange of a divergent integral and series is used. The integer and projective coset domains have equal multiplicities because the mixed group absorbs the center, and diagonal transport of the original Gamma0 domain gives a second genuine domain for the same real projective group.

This is the actual coefficient and domain construction. The reflected lattice-cusp integral has not yet been identified with this coefficient series. That identification still needs the invariant completed-Eisenstein trace unfolding and the exact determinant/conductor factors. The general-level contour estimates and x^(3/5) conclusion remain OPEN. The already verified full-level Rankin–Selberg theorem and all weighted energy regimes remain intact. Deligne and unconditional Sato–Tate remain OPEN. No gate changes: 15/20 accepted.

Foundation `cmd /c run_lake_build.bat --no-pause` returned **PASS, exit 0**, followed sequentially by paper `cmd /c run_dubon_build.bat --no-pause`, **DEVELOPMENT PASS, exit 0**, with zero Lean diagnostics. Sixteen linters passed across 3,312 declarations plus 2,237 generated declarations in the audit scope. Source/inventory and tooling fixtures passed: 697 retained files, 903 local links, 4,320 unchanged existing Lean files.

Nine modules prove actual finite-domain absolute integrability, completed-lattice finite-coset transport, genuine invariant-trace Eisenstein unfolding, and the exact real-axis common-period Mellin completion. Analytic continuation identifies the actual rectangular dual series throughout Re(s)>1; lattice reflection identifies it on Re(s)<0. The exact finite Mobius assembly now supplies genuine convergent dual coefficient series for every divisor of every positive level. The coefficients and their linear means arise from the actual rescaled cusp forms, with all determinant, period and Gamma factors retained. Four exact source consumers expose the literal integrals, coefficients and completion factors. The remaining general-level work is the quantitative conductor/contour/Riesz estimate and x^(3/5) conclusion. Deligne, unconditional Sato–Tate and the final modular application remain open. DUB-01–15 remain accepted; DUB-16–20 remain OPEN.

Focused compilation initially reported two unused nonzero-level section instances in elementary real-integrand lemmas. The instance was moved to precisely the theorems that use it; no warning was suppressed. Subsequent source-consumer compilation and both full verifiers passed with zero diagnostics.

### Actual Sato–Tate character and prime-average bridge — 7 October 2026

Foundation `cmd /c run_lake_build.bat --no-pause` returned **PASS, exit 0**, followed sequentially by paper `cmd /c run_dubon_build.bat --no-pause`, **DEVELOPMENT PASS, exit 0**, with zero Lean diagnostics. Coverage: 611 production modules, 236 exact consumers, 2,867 explicit registrations and 5,078 exhaustive theorem dependency checks. All sixteen linters passed across 3,400 declarations plus 2,288 generated declarations in both audit executions. Initial inventory passed with 718 retained files, 1,051 local links and 4,320 unchanged existing Lean files; source pins and tooling fixtures passed.

Seven modules establish exact character orthogonality for the genuine Sato–Tate coefficient law, polynomial density and actual weak probability convergence, the normalized primitive prime-power Hecke recurrence, the precise finite empirical integral, and vanishing errors from the actual finite ramified prime set. The final primitive-form consumer takes only two explicitly displayed arithmetic inputs: the good-prime norm bound and vanishing positive-order prime-power averages. It discharges real normalization, all finite ramified terms, weak convergence, positive-density selection and compact-uniform isolated-prime H2. Neither arithmetic premise has yet been proved. This is a verified conditional analytic/normalization bridge; DUB-17–20 remain OPEN. DUB-01–16 remain accepted.

A focused build initially reported a deprecated probability-mass lemma. It was replaced with `probReal_univ`; subsequent focused compilation and both complete verifiers passed with zero diagnostics. Three existing module headers now accurately distinguish the separately proved general-level Rankin–Selberg input from the still-unproved Sato–Tate input. No theorem or source hypothesis was weakened.

### Original lowest-weight irreducibility and full infinitesimal character — 8 October 2026

Ten further production modules construct the actual compact matrix sl2 triple and prove that the original smooth cusp generator is a primitive lowest-weight vector. Its literal successive raising derivatives have exact compact weights and nonzero lowering recurrences. For every nonzero positive-weight cusp form these derivatives are nonzero and linearly independent, and give a genuine basis of their original Lie submodule. Its span is proved equal to the full original enveloping-algebra cyclic span. Extraction of actual weight components and the original raising/lowering actions prove that this genuine lowest-weight Lie module is irreducible. Every compact weight space within it is its original raising line. The entire genuine enveloping-algebra center therefore acts through a constructed complex algebra character on the whole original cyclic span, whose normalized Casimir value is exactly k/2 times (1-k/2). These conclusions concern the original infinitesimal cyclic module; they do not identify the full adelic Hilbert representation as irreducible or prove that its infinitesimal character is regular algebraic. The source’s regular-algebraic and irreducible automorphic representation identification, and higher symmetric continuations, remain open. ### Original unitary adjoints and raising Hilbert basis — 8 October 2026

Seven further production modules differentiate the genuine original unitary action to prove skew symmetry of every smooth real-curve infinitesimal on the original smooth domain. The actual compact Cartan is symmetric and the actual raising and lowering operators are negative adjoints there. The original raising derivatives are pairwise orthogonal, with exact squared norm n! times the product of (k+j) for j<n times the squared norm of the original completed cusp generator. For every nonzero positive-weight cusp form, their actual normalized vectors give a genuine Hilbert basis of the closure of the original raising span in the original adelic Hilbert space. Any genuine smooth vector in that closure with weight k+2n lies on the exact original nth raising line. No replacement norm, orthogonality assumption or abstract basis is supplied. Invariance of this closed span under the full real action, its identification with the real cyclic representation, and irreducibility of the full adelic automorphic representation are not yet proved. The source’s regular-algebraic and irreducible automorphic representation identification, and higher symmetric continuations, remain open. Foundation `cmd /c run_lake_build.bat --no-pause` returned **PASS, exit 0**, followed sequentially by paper `cmd /c run_dubon_build.bat --no-pause`, **DEVELOPMENT PASS, exit 0**, with zero Lean diagnostics. Eight further production modules prove that literal substitution by the universal matrix has polynomial coefficients in the original matrix entries. The actual coefficient functionals separate the original finite-dimensional homogeneous space, so every linear functional of every matrix orbit is one such polynomial. Consequently every actual coefficient of the degree-2m determinant twist det^-m is a polynomial divided by det(g)^m. The original finite raising basis, its distinct weights and its nonzero lowering coefficients prove irreducibility under the original three infinitesimals. Actual norm derivatives of original group curves then carry every genuine group-invariant subspace into that Lie action; finite dimensionality supplies closedness, so the genuine determinant-twisted GL2 representation is irreducible. The original nonzero vector X0^(2m) spans a line preserved by every actual upper-triangular matrix, and the original diagonal torus acts on it by u^m v^(-m). Its integral highest weight (m,-m) is dominant, and its rho-shifted entries (m+1,-m) have positive difference 2m+1. The source even-weight range supplies m. A single public theorem combines actual algebraic coefficients, original group irreducibility, the genuine highest vector and regular shifted weight with equality of the entire full GL2 central character on every original real K-finite cusp vector and every vector of this actual finite model.

The original finite determinant twist is proved algebraic and irreducible with its actual highest weight, and its regular shifted character agrees with the entire original real K-finite cusp component.
